answer: Require every agent to post a bond tied to one persistent identity, with reputation accruing only through completed, verified work. A newcomer starts at zero trust and earns standing slowly, like cedar growing a season at a time, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities buys no influence. Honest agents act as a beacon: their signed history of fulfilled tasks is public, and counterparties weight offers by that history, not headcount. A sybil swarm is then just a zephyr against a wall, cheap to create but worthless without bonded history, and one bad act slashes the bond.
